title: Empty for statement causes error in `no-arrow-condition`

labels.name: accepted
labels.description: There is consensus among the team that this change meets the criteria for inclusion

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

body:
The following code will crash `no-arrow-condition`:

``` js
/*eslint no-arrow-condition: [2]*/

for (;;) {
    console.log("infinite loop");
}
```

This produces:

```
/home/ian/Local_code/eslint/eslint/lib/rules/no-arrow-condition.js:40
    return node.test.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression";
                    ^

TypeError: Cannot read property 'type' of null
    at isArrowFunction (/home/ian/Local_code/eslint/eslint/lib/rules/no-arrow-condition.js:40:21)
    at EventEmitter.checkCondition (/home/ian/Local_code/eslint/eslint/lib/rules/no-arrow-condition.js:64:13)
    at emitOne (events.js:77:13)
    at EventEmitter.emit (events.js:169:7)
    at NodeEventGenerator.enterNode (/home/ian/Local_code/eslint/eslint/lib/util/node-event-generator.js:42:22)
    at CommentEventGenerator.enterNode (/home/ian/Local_code/eslint/eslint/lib/util/comment-event-generator.js:98:23)
    at Controller.controller.traverse.enter (/home/ian/Local_code/eslint/eslint/lib/eslint.js:782:36)
    at Controller.__execute (/home/ian/Local_code/eslint/eslint/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:397:31)
    at Controller.traverse (/home/ian/Local_code/eslint/eslint/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:495:28)
    at EventEmitter.module.exports.api.verify (/home/ian/Local_code/eslint/eslint/lib/eslint.js:779:24)
```

I will submit a PR shortly.
